ZunaVision: Embed Videos and Images Within Existing Video

Andy CASA, UCL East

Video manipulation is becoming the next big thing online. Techniques that were once limited to high end commercial studios are coming out as web based services, services that have huge potential for data communication and visualisation.

Take a look at the latest service from Standard University below, known as ZunaVision:



Note how the shadows fall on the walls as well as the video, if you have a video you would like a try the simple go to http://zunavision.stanford.edu/ to try it out.
